title: No full roster in inbound metadata — agents can't see room members
description:
## From oc-dive-a2a investigation

Agents receive target_persona_ids (who to wake) and lead_persona_id in inbound metadata. Agents do NOT receive full personaIds[] list of all room members.

No join/leave events broadcast to connected agents. No agent presence/online status signal.

## Impact

Agents have no way to know who else is in the room. This blocks delegation (@mention of unseen agents), room-aware behavior, and multi-agent coordination.

## Fix

BFF stampGroupDeliverInbound should include full personaIds[] in metadata. Channel membership API should broadcast join/leave events via relay.

## Severity

Medium — real-time awareness gap. Not a hard blocker for single-agent reply but blocks multi-agent harmony (lp-8sh4).

title: @ picker derives agents from threads not catalog — agents without 1:1 invisible
description:
## From oc-dive-a2a investigation

File: portal/apps/web/src/features/chat/composerMailboxPicker.ts

@ picker uses `tenantAgentsFromThreads(threads)` — derives agents from loaded thread list, NOT the durable `GET /api/agents` catalog.

Consequence: if agent exists in catalog but has no 1:1 thread, it won't appear in @ picker until refresh.

`asDurableAgent()` defaults to 'New agent' when no name provided. Three agents all labeled 'New agent' with different dither colors.

## Fix

tenantAgentsFromThreads should fall back to listAgents() catalog. Also ensure agents have distinct displayNames set in CP.

title: Harness turn_37 streamed zero tokens — stall watchdog would catch (ships in #670)
description:
## Symptom

BFF logged [harness-proxy] streaming turn turn_37 (cf216dee-2445-4d43-aae8-fdc619781d2f) at 06:33:41 ET. No follow-up line — no completion, no error, no tokens. Harness ECS task :14 running since 2026-08-22. CP socket capacity warnings at 50/50 (06:30-06:32 ET). Idle-reaper killed box at 06:37:18 (skipped_mid_turn=0).

## Fix in PR #670

PR #670 (lp-v62i.8) adds HARNESS_TURN_STALL_TIMEOUT_MS (default 120s). If harness stream is silent for 120s, watchdog tears down the turn and surfaces the error. This prevents indefinite hangs.

## Root cause

Unknown why harness produced zero tokens. Possible:
- Harness agent core stuck/timeout
- CP socket saturation (50 capacity + 173 queued)
- Stale harness task (running since Aug 22)

## Action

After #670 merges: if harness still produces empty turns, investigate harness ECS task health. The watchdog surfaces the failure instead of silent hang. No separate bead needed if #670 stalls watchdog catches it.

Blocked on: lp-v62i.8 (PR #670 merge)

title: @ picker: three 'New agent' rows — display names not distinct in multi-agent channels
description:
## Symptom

Taste 2026-08-26 7:23 AM QA: @ picker in #test-group shows three rows all labeled 'New agent' (pink/purple/blue). Connectors section shows Google Workspace, HubSpot, WhatsApp, GitHub (correct). Agents should show distinct display names.

## Context

- lp-v62i.2.4 shipped #621: Composer @ picker shows agents then provisioned connectors
- lp-8sh4.4 shipped #617: Stream hover card + @displayName chips
- All three agents in MockLab are named 'New agent' — either:
  (a) display names were never set (default is 'New agent'), OR
  (b) picker renders displayName but agents have no custom name

## Question

Is this a bug or a data issue? If agents have no display name configured in MockLab, the picker is correct (showing the default). If display names are set but picker ignores them, that's a code bug.

## Action

Check whether MockLab agents have distinct displayNames in CP. If not, set them via /admin or tenant config. If yes, investigate picker rendering in portal packages/web ChatView or Composer.
